from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import json
for p in sorted(Path('.').glob('*/observer.json')):
 o=json.loads(p.read_text())
 b=[json.loads(l) for l in (p.parent/'after'/'browser-record.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
 start=o['actual_events'][0]
 stop=o['actual_events'][-1]
 idx=iter(b[1:-1])
 missing=[]
 for ce in o['actual_events'][1:-1]:
  match=next((e for e in idx if e['args']==ce['args'] and e['exit']==ce['runtime_exit'] and e['output_sha256']==ce['stdout_sha256'] and all(line in e.get('output','').splitlines() for line in ce.get('observed_lines',[]))),None)
  if not match: missing.append(ce['args'])
 valid=all(sha256(e['output'].encode()).hexdigest()==e['output_sha256'] for e in b if 'output' in e)
 print(p, \"start_match\", start==b[0], \"stop_match\",stop==b[-1],\"missing\",missing,\"stdout hashes\",valid)
PY"
